description: In this weeks episode I sat down with international bestselling author of Sapiens, Homo Deus and 21 Lessons for the 21st Century, Yuval Harari.We covered so many interesting topics like how to manage expectations, the importance of boredom and what he believes the future of artificial intelligence is. He also shares with us his equation for happiness and he reveals why so many of us are addicted to being on our phones.We also dove into education and where he believes the job market will be 30 ye…
classificationReason: Includes a substantial discussion of artificial intelligence, education, and the future job market, though it is not robotics-specific.
qualityReason: Likely a substantive interview with a prominent author covering multiple developed topics.
